title: Shakti-2 NonStop Garba
description: A 2022 continuous Shakti-2 Garba recording by Rushabh Ahir and Santvani Trivedi, released by Zen Music Gujarati. This nonstop-only edition remains separate from the canonical 26-song Shakti-2 release; exact duration seconds remain intentionally unset.
label: Zen Music Gujarati
notes: Apple exposes the continuous edition as one 47-minute song; exact seconds remain intentionally unset. A separate 26-song edition also exists and is not collapsed into this master.
